title: Counsel to the Pure in Heart
summary: Jacob addresses those pure in heart, urging them to look to God, pray, receive God’s word, and feast upon his love.

explicit_facts.text: Jacob addresses those who are pure in heart.
He urges them to look to God with firmness of mind, pray with exceeding faith, and receive consolation and divine advocacy.
He invites them to lift their heads, receive the pleasing word of God, and feast upon his love.

title: Warning to the Impure
summary: Jacob warns that unless his hearers repent, the land will be cursed, the Lamanites will scourge them and possess their inheritance, and the righteous will be led away.

explicit_facts.text: Jacob warns those not pure in heart to repent.
He says the Lamanites will scourge them unto destruction and possess their land of inheritance unless they repent.
He says the Lord God will lead the righteous away from among them.

title: The Lamanites Keep the Commandment
summary: Jacob says the Lamanites observe the commandment concerning marriage and will therefore be spared destruction, shown mercy, and one day become blessed.

explicit_facts.text: Jacob says the Lamanites are more righteous than his audience because they have not forgotten the commandment given to their father.
The commandment permits one wife and forbids concubines and whoredoms.
Jacob says the Lamanites observe the commandment, and God will not destroy them but will be merciful; one day they will become a blessed people.

title: Love Within Lamanite Families
summary: Jacob describes Lamanite spouses loving one another and their children, then warns his audience of judgment if they do not repent.

explicit_facts.text: Jacob says Lamanite husbands and wives love one another and their children.
He attributes their unbelief and hatred toward his audience to their fathers' iniquity.
Jacob fears that unless his hearers repent, the Lamanites' skins will be whiter than theirs when they are brought together before God's throne.

title: Do Not Revile Them
summary: Jacob commands his hearers not to revile the Lamanites and reminds them that their example has grieved their children and may bring them to destruction.

explicit_facts.text: Jacob commands his hearers not to revile the Lamanites because of skin darkness or filthiness.
He tells them to remember their own filthiness and that the Lamanites' filthiness came because of their fathers.
Jacob says they have grieved their children's hearts by their example and may bring their children to destruction.

title: The Plates and the Record
summary: Jacob says only a hundredth part of the people's proceedings can be written on these plates; many proceedings, wars, contentions, and reigns are recorded on the larger plates. He names these the plates of Jacob, says Nephi made them, and ends his words.

explicit_facts.text: Jacob says the people began to be numerous and that a hundredth part of their proceedings cannot be written on these plates.
Many proceedings, wars, contentions, and kings' reigns are written on the larger plates.
These plates are called the plates of Jacob and were made by Nephi.
Jacob makes an end of speaking these words.
